narrative: Builders shipped 6,028 new Spaces this week (+3.2%), and chat and assistants remains the largest named use case at 914. Underneath the flat headline, the mix tilted toward work: enterprise productivity climbed to 6.7% of new Spaces (+1.0 points) and document AI reached 362, while data analysis and e-commerce tooling both pulled back. On the model side 26,015 new models arrived (+6.3%), with the other open models bucket up +39.0% and GLM / Zhipu derivatives up +405.2% from a very small base.
